name: session-dashboard
description: A /dash panel: context, estimated cost, tokens and cache hit rate, subagents (type, model, status, cost), skills and who loaded them, tools and files edited. Draws nothing outside its panel, so it never clashes with other bands such as ponytail's.

budget.title: Cost alert (USD)
budget.description: Show a toast once the session's estimated cost passes this amount

autoOpen.title: Open at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the dashboard panel when a session starts (/dash still toggles it)
